audit.whatIsWrong: Difficulty prose was generic Katarina boilerplate; the actual difficulty driver is Mel's 950-range Radiant Volley level 1 and her single defensive button afterwards.
audit.why: 58.31% win rate over 1775 games with the packet chart giving Mel only Level 1. Mel has no dash and Rebuttal (W) is 38s at rank 1, so every other stage is Katarina's.
audit.corrected: Concede level 1 to Radiant Volley's 950 range, take the lane back at 3, and treat Rebuttal's cooldown as the difficulty clock.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike prose named no Mel cooldown; spikes[2].text stated Rebuttal is '~20s+' which is not its cooldown.
audit.why: Rebuttal is 38/35/33/29/26s. Golden Eclipse is 120/100/80s. Death Lotus is 75/60/45s.
audit.corrected: Level 3 sets the lane; level 6 kills her once Rebuttal is baited; first item is a one-rotation kill inside her 38s W downtime.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interaction was stated only as 'reflects your projectiles back' with no split between what it does and does not reflect.
audit.why: Katarina's Q and Death Lotus daggers carry the projectile flag; dagger pickups (passive) do not. So Rebuttal turns R around but cannot stop pickup damage. Solar Snare (E) is hardCC on 11/10.5/10/9.5/9s and is what actually kills Katarina in this lane.
audit.corrected: Bait Rebuttal with a Q or an E feint before channelling R; trade through dagger pickups meanwhile; never Shunpo in with Solar Snare available.

audit.whatIsWrong: Searing Brilliance (P) auto-reset tell was absent.
audit.why: brief.missingInteractions rule autoreset-burst-tell: Mel's bonus-projectile attack after an ability cast is the burst cue.
audit.corrected: Folded into dosFull[1].d — step in after her Q lands, not while the empowered attack is loaded.

audit.whatIsWrong: 16 lint findings: 11 misgendered fields (Mel is she/her), 2 copy-paste bleeds, 1 cooldowns field with no digit.

edits.before: - Mel Rebuttal: matchup-defining — Reflects your projectiles back — never poke while it glows. Check it before every step-up. - E Shunpo (second use) is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
